clients.title: Webhooks
clients.description: Each API client has its own endpoints: pick the client whose webhooks you manage.
clients.name: API client
clients.empty: No API clients yet. Create one first: webhooks belong to a client.

endpoints.title: Webhooks of {{client}}
endpoints.description: The URLs that receive this client's events, signed with a secret shown once.

disabled.gone: Switched off, the URL is gone

form.createDescription: Its signing secret is shown once, after you create it.
form.editDescription: Change where and what is sent. The secret stays as it is.
form.urlHint: A public https:// address. Private and cloud-metadata addresses are refused.
form.urlInvalid: Enter a full web address, such as https://example.com/hooks.
form.eventsHint: Everything the API sends, or only the types you tick.

secret.warning: You won't see this secret again. Copy it now and keep it somewhere safe.
secret.usage: Verify each delivery's webhook-signature with it (Standard Webhooks). After a rotation, the old secret keeps signing next to it for 24 hours.
secret.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the secret and copy it by hand.
secret.label: Signing secret

detail.title: Endpoint
detail.testSent: Test event sent: see it in the deliveries.
detail.rotateDescription: A new secret is made and shown once. The old one keeps signing next to it for 24 hours, so your receiver can switch over.
detail.deleteDescription: It stops receiving events at once, and its deliveries are no longer shown. This can't be undone.

deliveries.title: Deliveries
deliveries.description: What was sent to this endpoint, newest first. Open one to see the request and the response.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.sentAt: Attempt {{attempt}}, sent {{date}}. The secret is never shown.

retryFailed.title: Retry the failed deliveries?
retryFailed.description: Every failed delivery of this endpoint is sent again, with the same message id.

senders.title: Incoming webhook senders
senders.description: Systems that may POST signed events to this tenant. Each has a name, a URL and a signing secret shown once.
senders.switchedOff: Sender switched off: its calls are refused.
senders.rotateDescription: A new secret is made and shown once. The old one keeps verifying for 24 hours, so the sender can switch over.
senders.deleteDescription: Its calls are refused from now on. This can't be undone.
senders.secretUsage: The sender signs each call with it (Standard Webhooks) and POSTs to its URL. After a rotation, the old secret keeps verifying for 24 hours.

form.createDescription: Its signing secret is shown once, after you create it.
form.editDescription: Change the description. The name is part of its URL.
form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens: the last part of its URL.
form.nameInvalid: Use lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, at most 63 characters.

scope.label: Also send events about the tenant's other records
scope.description: Records created by users and other clients, only those this client may read, without the fields it may not read. Off: only this client's own records.
